item.title: October 28, 2026: Architectural Asphalt vs. Class 4 Impact Shingles: 3-Pitch Tear-Off & Insurance Premium Audit
item.description: Counter-Intuitive Takeaway: On steep-slope roofs (8/12+ pitch), labor staging and safety rigging represent 42% of the total bid—upgrading from standard architectural shingles to SBS-modified Class 4 impact shingles adds only ~12% to the turnkey quote while extending service life by 8–10 years.
